slides.h: GIVE YOUR SHOP ONE [[MONEY HOUR]] EVERY WEEK
slides.dek: A four-part Sunday routine that tells you whether you truly made a profit.

items: **Export the week's orders** from every channel you sell on. One folder, one week.
**Download settlement statements.** What the platform paid you matters more than what buyers paid.
**Photograph paper receipts today.** Courier slips fade and vanish by month end.
**Three columns are enough:** money in, money out, stock bought.
**Record every fee as a cost.** Commission, shipping, payment charges. They are real money.
**Mark COD orders as pending** until the settlement lands, never as received.
**Match each settlement to its orders.** A missing amount gets found this week or never.
**List returns and RTOs on their own line.** Each one reversed a sale and added a cost.
**Raise disputes now.** Claim windows close while you are busy selling.
**Write one number: cash today vs last Sunday.** The direction matters more than the amount.
**Find the week's biggest cost and question it.** Same courier? Same packaging rate?
**Set one money action for the week.** A reorder, a markdown, or a rate renegotiation.

slides.h: SAVE THIS. RUN IT EVERY SUNDAY.
slides.body: Sellers who know their numbers weekly make festival-season decisions in minutes. Everyone else guesses.
